history_embedding.layernorm: applied once to the complete initial history sequence

selector_insertion.position: after initial-history LayerNorm and before the first PLM forward

autoregressive.attention_mask: all ones, current full sequence length

loss: torch.nn.MSELoss over normalized prediction and normalized future

evaluation.upstream_mae: mean absolute coordinate error; rotation=True supported
evaluation.upstream_rmse: sqrt(mean squared coordinate error); source ignores rotation argument
